title: 第173章 “她是我的妻子。”
slug: 万一小叔对假千金是柏拉图呢
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

祝砚铮墨瞳稍怔，看向面前的冯先生。

冯·格林瓦尔德不仅算是合作伙伴，两人在各自国家的政界也都着举足轻重的地位。

两人在很多事物的看法和理念上都有着相似点，这也是冯先生能够被祝砚铮亲自接待的原因。

每次跟祝砚铮交谈聊天时，冯先生都一副相见恨晚的模样，倾盖如故，滔滔不绝。

祝砚铮本人谦逊稳重，面对他这位“朋友”时，也乐意奉陪到底。

只不过这次见面，竟然只聊了一个半小时？

“祝，你很奇怪，”冯先生眯了眯眼，审视着面前高大俊美的男人，“你的庄园里是不是有水妖？”

冯痴迷于各种神话故事，国内国外的各种神话故事，他都看了不少。

但他的中文理解力其实不算太好，他只是知道神话故事里的水妖都是榨精吸髓，让人流连忘返，乐不思蜀的存在。

他刚才就注意到，跟祝用餐期间，他虽然也在参与着交谈，但目光时不时地会瞥向桌案上的手机。

好像在等待谁的来电一样。

祝砚铮轻笑一声：“水妖？”

“对，用你们国人的话，应该是狐精，”冯点点头，“她们都很会迷惑人，让你爱她无法自拔，无法脱身。”

男人眸光清冷，语气平静：“她不是水妖。”

冯听到他这样说，眼中闪过一抹兴奋的光：“所以真的有人在等你！？祝，是谁？”

祝砚铮墨瞳微凝，有一瞬的出神。

刚刚庄园里的厨师发来消息，今天的晚餐，她没吃多少。

她其实不太喜欢吃过于甜腻的味道，祝砚铮看了一眼厨师发来的菜品，大概是今晚的甜粥和酒酿鱼不太合她的口味。

所以他叫了后厨打包了几份她爱吃的菜品。

“祝，是谁‘迷惑’了性冷淡的你？”

或许他应该在路上再给她打包一份甜品。

她爱吃的那家甜品店他办了黑卡，不用排队就能拿到甜点。

只不过不能买多了，她最近喊着牙疼，应该是有了蛀牙。

“祝，是谁让你无法自拔，无法脱身？”

对于甜品，祝砚铮其实谈不上喜不喜欢。

但因为她总说，所以他也了解到了许多关于甜品的名称和制作方法。

有时他也会想，或许可以单独开几家甜品店，招聘几个她爱吃的口味甜品师，让她想吃的时候，随时就能吃上。

但转念一想，这样就又太溺爱她了。

——她年纪还小，吃这么多甜点总归不太好。

“祝，你在想什么？”

冯先生上前几步，脸上写满了八卦与兴奋，似乎迫切地想要知道祝砚铮的“水妖”是谁。

缓缓回神。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Zhu Yanzheng's eyes were slightly startled and he looked at Mr. Feng in front of him.

Von Grunwald was not only a partner, the two also played a pivotal role in the political circles of their respective countries.

The two have similar views and concepts on many things, which is why Mr. Feng was able to be received by Zhu Yanzheng personally.

Every time he chatted with Zhu Yanzheng, Mr. Feng looked like he was sorry for meeting him so late, and he kept talking as usual.

Zhu Yanzheng himself is humble and steady, and when facing his "friend", he is willing to stay with him until the end.

But this time we met, we only chatted for an hour and a half?

"Zhu, you are very strange." Mr. Feng squinted his eyes and examined the tall and handsome man in front of him. "Is there a water monster in your manor?"

Feng was obsessed with all kinds of myths and stories, and he had read a lot of all kinds of myths at home and abroad.

But his understanding of Chinese is actually not very good. He just knows that the water monsters in mythical stories squeeze the essence and suck the marrow, making people linger and forget about their existence.

He just noticed that during the meal with Zhu, although he was also participating in the conversation, his eyes would glance at the mobile phone on the table from time to time.

As if waiting for a call from someone.

Zhu Yanzheng chuckled: "Water demon?"

"Yes, in the words of your countrymen, they should be fox spirits," Feng nodded. "They are all very good at confusing people, making you fall in love with her and be unable to help yourself or escape."

The man's eyes were cold and his tone was calm: "She is not a water demon."

When Feng heard what he said, a flash of excitement flashed in his eyes: "So someone is really waiting for you!? Zhu, who is it?"

Zhu Yanzheng's dark pupils were slightly focused, and he was lost in thought for a moment.

The chef at the manor just sent a message that she didn't eat much for today's dinner.

She actually doesn't like overly sweet food. Zhu Yanzheng took a look at the dishes sent by the chef. It was probably because tonight's sweet porridge and wine-stuffed fish were not to her taste.

So he asked the chef to pack some of her favorite dishes.

"Zhu, who 'confused' you who are frigid?"

Maybe he should pack her another dessert on the way.

He applied for a black card at the dessert shop she loved, so he could get desserts without queuing.

It’s just that I can’t buy too much. She recently complained that she had a toothache, so she probably had cavities.

"Zhu, who makes you unable to extricate yourself and unable to escape?"

Regarding desserts, Zhu Yanzheng couldn't say whether he liked them or not.

But because she always talked, he also learned a lot about the names of desserts and how to make them.

Sometimes he also thinks that maybe he can open a few dessert shops alone and recruit a few dessert chefs with her favorite flavors so that she can eat them whenever she wants.

But then I thought about it, this would be too doting on her.

——She is still young, so it is not good to eat so many desserts.

"Zhu, what are you thinking about?"

Mr. Feng took a few steps forward, his face full of gossip and excitement, as if he was eager to know who Zhu Yanzheng's "water demon" was.

Slowly regain consciousness.
